encounter.clinical_summary: Maria Lopez, a 46-year-old female with hypertension, presented to the emergency department with intermittent chest discomfort. Initial vital signs were stable. An electrocardiogram showed normal sinus rhythm without acute ischemic changes, and the initial troponin result was within the normal reference range. The available documentation describes emergency department evaluation and discharge later the same day. The submitted record does not document placement into observation status, an observation start time, or continued monitoring during an observation period.
